items.title: Red Flag Warning issued April 8 at 1:34AM EDT until April 8 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
items.summary:
The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a Red Flag
Warning, which is in effect from noon today to 8 PM EDT this
evening.

* AFFECTED AREA...Georgia fire weather zones 125, 126, 127, 128,
129, 130, and 131.

* WIND...Northeast to east 15 to 20 mph, with gusts 25 to 35 mph.

* HUMIDITY...As low as 25 percent.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will likely spread rapidly.
Outdoor burning is not recommended.
